commits.subject: * Refactor HeadingInterpolator into an interface with distinct TankHeadingInterpolator and HolonomicHeadingInterpolator classes for strict kinematic separation. * Split movement builders (HolonomicPathBuilder, TankPathBuilder, TurnBuilder) into quickBuild() and profiledBuild() to support pure geometric fallback generation. * Add generateQuick() to dynamically generate naive trapezoidal profiles, fulfilling Ramsete controller reference requirements for Tank drives without iterative physics simulations. * Update Follower holonomic and turn execution loops to conditionally apply dynamic feedforward parameters or fallback to pure PDS positional tracking based on path profile state. * Replace custom lambda heading interpolator with NODE_BASED interpolation, utilizing a newly implemented CubicSpline1D (Thomas Algorithm) to guarantee C2 continuous heading control. * Implement continuous shortest-path angular unwrapping for NODE_BASED heading splines to prevent erratic snapping across 2-PI boundaries. * Fix TurnBuilder callback bug by converting build tasks to Consumer, ensuring callbacks map to accurate swept angles. * Integrate DrivetrainType parsing into FollowerConstants.json loading logic to automate physics generator routing (Mecanum vs. Swerve vs. Tank). * Add runtime safety warnings to path builders if quickBuild() is invoked without attached kinematic constraints. * Overhaul API showcase files (ExampleAutoPath, FullAPIShowcase) to demonstrate profiledBuild(), quickBuild(), and the new node-based heading architecture.

commits.subject: * Refactor HeadingInterpolator into an interface with distinct TankHeadingInterpolator and HolonomicHeadingInterpolator classes for strict kinematic separation. * Split movement builders (HolonomicPathBuilder, TankPathBuilder, TurnBuilder) into quickBuild() and profiledBuild() to support pure geometric fallback generation. * Add generateQuick() to dynamically generate naive trapezoidal profiles, fulfilling Ramsete controller reference requirements for Tank drives without iterative physics simulations. * Update Follower holonomic and turn execution loops to conditionally apply dynamic feedforward parameters or fallback to pure PDS positional tracking based on path profile state. * Replace custom lambda heading interpolator with NODE_BASED interpolation, utilizing a newly implemented CubicSpline1D (Thomas Algorithm) to guarantee C2 continuous heading control. * Implement continuous shortest-path angular unwrapping for NODE_BASED heading splines to prevent erratic snapping across 2-PI boundaries. * Fix TurnBuilder callback bug by converting build tasks to Consumer, ensuring callbacks map to accurate swept angles. * Integrate DrivetrainType parsing into FollowerConstants.json loading logic to automate physics generator routing (Mecanum vs. Swerve vs. Tank). * Add runtime safety warnings to path builders if quickBuild() is invoked without attached kinematic constraints. * Overhaul API showcase files (ExampleAutoPath, FullAPIShowcase) to demonstrate profiledBuild(), quickBuild(), and the new node-based heading architecture.
